about: Shared by packages/exactdocs/tests/ingestion/test_chunker.py and web/src/features/browse/render/anchors.test.ts. `anchors` are the anchors of the top-level headings, in order; the chunker and the web renderer must agree on every one.

cases.name: punctuation drops, dashes and underscores stay
markup is plain text, code keeps its text
repeats count across the whole article, at every level
a taken suffix is skipped, and an issued slug is remembered
headings in block quotes take a slug but are not chunks
inline HTML tags add no text, their content does
unicode letters and digits stay, symbols and emoji go

# Привет, мир

cases.name: setext headings, trailing hashes and extra spaces
a heading made of symbols only has an empty slug
fenced code is not a heading
